name: sentry_list_issues
description: List issues (grouped errors) in a Sentry project, newest activity first. Provide `project_slug` (from sentry_list_projects). Optional: `query` is a Sentry search string and defaults to `is:unresolved` when omitted (examples: `is:unresolved level:error`, `is:unresolved firstSeen:-24h`, `assigned:me`); `statsPeriod` bounds the window (e.g. `24h` default, `14d`); `limit` caps results (max 100). Each issue includes `id` (numeric, used by sentry_get_issue / sentry_update_issue), `shortId`, `title`, `culprit`, `level`, `status`, `count`, `userCount`, `firstSeen`, and `lastSeen`.

project_slug.description: The project's slug (the `slug` field from sentry_list_projects).

query.description: Optional Sentry search query. Defaults to `is:unresolved` if omitted.

limit.description: Optional max number of issues to return (max 100).
